newsitem.title: USA: Gundle says Q2 EPS won't meet expectations.
newsitem.headline: Gundle says Q2 EPS won't meet expectations.

text.p: Gundle/SLT Environmental Inc said Wednesday it expects to record a second quarter profit of between $0.04 and $0.06 per share, well short of the First Call consensus estimate of $0.14 per share.

Company president and chief executive officer Bill Reid said in a statement continuing price competition and higher raw materials costs have reduced margin to about 18 percent from 27 percent in the same period a year ago, when the company recorded a profit of $0.26 per share.
Reid also said North American unit sales will be down in the second quarter, although overall sales are up for the first half of the year.
The company's overall unit order backlog will be higher at June 30 than at the same time a year ago, he said.
Reid said the company is on track with its plan to open a manufacturing facility in Asia in early 1998, which should help lower the cost of raw materials.
Reid also said the company continues to seek joint ventures and strategic alliances to help increase its international market share.
